title: WaveformProcessed
description: Published by Waveform on routing key waveform.processed once a song's waveform is stored and retrievable from GET /api/waveform/songs/{song_id}/waveform. Catalogue sets waveform_status = READY. May be published again for the same song (duplicate SongUploaded delivery); consumers must be idempotent.

points.description: Number of peak values stored for the song.

duration_ms.description: Audio duration measured while decoding, in milliseconds.
